title: Export with dependencies is missing super classes
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.1.4.stable.official [fe0e8e557], v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8], v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6], v4.5.stable.arch_linux, v4.5.1.rc1.official [c834443ef], v4.6.dev1.official [8d8041bd4]

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable unknown - EndeavourOS # 1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 02 Oct 2025 13:18:36 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (ADL GT2) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1280P (20 threads) - 31.05 GiB memory

### Issue description

When using the "Export selected scenes (and dependencies)" option, I would expect it to export my game such that the super classes of any class I use in a scene or resource are exported.

However, when using this option, classes which inherit from some super class that I've defined do not work because the super class has not been exported:

```
Godot Engine v4.5.stable.official.876b29033 - https://godotengine.org
Inconsistent value (1) for DRI_PRIME. Should be < 1 (GPU devices count). Using: 0
OpenGL API 4.6 (Core Profile) Mesa 25.2.4-arch1.1 - Compatibility - Using Device: Intel - Mesa Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (ADL GT2)

SCRIPT ERROR: Parse Error: Could not resolve super class "LabelBase".
          at: GDScript::reload (res://label_hello.gd:1)
ERROR: Failed to load script "res://label_hello.gd" with error "Parse error".
   at: load (modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp:3041)
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a class `A`.
2. Create another class `B` which extends class `A`.
3. Use `B` in a scene.
4. Export the game in release mode using the "Export selected scenes (and dependencies)" option with that scene selected.
5. Observe that the exported game fails to resolve super class `A`.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[deps.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22782736/deps.zip)
